requirements.title: Transmit Raw Byte Payload
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall transmit caller-supplied raw byte payloads over the RYLR896 radio.
requirements.rationale: Telem_lib provides serialized telemetry bytes; lora_lib is responsible for getting them on the air.

requirements.title: Payload Content Opacity
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall not interpret or modify the content of caller-supplied payload bytes.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: lora_lib is a transport-only driver; telem_lib owns packet structure and content.

requirements.title: Sustain 2 Hz Send Cadence
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall complete each transmit call within the period required to sustain 2 Hz downlink.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-019; driver send time must not stall the 2 Hz telemetry app.

requirements.title: AT-Command Configuration Interface
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall configure the radio address, network ID, frequency, spreading factor, and bandwidth at initialization.
requirements.rationale: RYLR896 requires AT-command configuration of these parameters before payload transmission is reliable.

requirements.title: Power-On Self-Test Probe
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall probe the RYLR896 with an AT command and verify an OK response at startup.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-029; POST must confirm the radio module is responsive before flight.

requirements.title: Continuous Health Reporting
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall report a health status reflecting the most recent transmit and module-response outcome.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-031 and SW-REQ-SYS-061; ongoing health observability for the radio is required.

requirements.title: Unhealthy on Send Failure
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall report unhealthy status when a transmit attempt fails.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-061; transmission failures must be surfaced via health state.

requirements.title: Unhealthy on Missing Module Response
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall report unhealthy status when the RYLR896 fails to respond to an AT command.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-061; lack of module response indicates a non-functional radio path.

requirements.title: Return Status on Send Failure
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall return a non-success status when a transmit call fails.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-036; callers must observe failure to continue operating without halting.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Implementations
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall provide functionally equivalent POSIX and Pico2 implementations behind one API.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation must exercise the same lora_lib API as flight.

requirements.title: Deterministic Behavior
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall produce deterministic outputs and status codes given identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-044; deterministic driver behavior is required for repeatable Trick runs.

requirements.title: Configurable UART Baud Rate
requirements.description: The LoRa library shall accept a UART baud rate as a configuration parameter at initialization.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: baud rate is configurable to match RYLR896 module settings without code changes.
